description:
Power your 72V LiFePO4 battery system with this high-performance 10A LFP battery charger, specially designed for 24S LFP battery packs.

With an output of 87.6V DC at 10A, the charger is designed to charge a 24-series-cell LiFePO4 battery pack to its full rated voltage. Its wide AC 160V–280V, 50/60Hz input range makes it suitable for use with varying mains voltage conditions.

The charger features a robust metal enclosure with a finned heat-dissipation design, helping manage heat during operation. The included power cable and charging connector provide a convenient, ready-to-use charging solution.

Ideal for compatible 72V LiFePO4 battery systems, including electric vehicles, e-rickshaws, scooters and other high-capacity lithium battery applications.

Important Compatibility Note
87.6V is specifically for a 24S LiFePO4 battery pack (24 × 3.65V). Before use, confirm that the battery's BMS and charging specifications support an 87.6V charging voltage and 10A charging current.
